candidate_sentences.text: Net sales for the Group declined by 16% to SEK 295.3 million compared with SEK 352.9 million in the previous year.
Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortisation decreased to SEK 17.5 million from SEK 46.7 million in 2024.

The operating result after depreciation, amortisation, and impairment of intangible non-current assets deteriorated to a loss of SEK 40.0 million compared with a loss of SEK 4.0 million in the previous year.
Cash flow from operating activities was negative at SEK 72.6 million, compared with a positive cash flow of SEK 56.8 million in 2024, affected by working capital changes and operating results.

Available cash and cash equivalents at year-end amounted to SEK 30.1 million down from SEK 49.7 million, while total available cash including the bank overdraft facility stood at SEK 80.1 million compared with SEK 70.8 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Business restructuring into two segments (Products & Missions and Data & Services) to enhance operational efficiency, with Data & Services segment growing net sales by approximately 80% to SEK 80M (from SEK 45M in 2024) driven by recurring maritime data revenues from operational Sedna satellites.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Operations section (page 9-11), CEO Review (page 6), Business segments highlights (page 11)

candidate_sentences.text: The Data & Services segment generated net sales of SEK 80.1 million, up from SEK 44.9 million in 2024, supported by an 80 percent increase driven by the expansion of proprietary satellite systems and recurring revenue streams.

verified_key_information_units.information: Major contract acquisitions including ESA's INFLECION Phase 1 agreement (part of a SEK 350M co-funded program with 50% UK Space Agency contribution) and SEK 11.8M order for EPS-Sterna weather constellation components, significantly boosting order backlog and providing multi-year revenue visibility.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: 2025 in brief (page 5), Board of Directors' Report (page 32), Significant events during the year (page 32)

verified_key_information_units.information: Key operational milestones: Sedna-1 and Sedna-2 satellites became fully operational strengthening maritime AIS network capacity; first CubeCAT laser communication terminals delivered enabling high-speed optical links; assembly commenced on first two VIREON™ Earth Observation satellites for 2026 launch.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: 2025 in brief (page 5), Weather technology praised by ESA section (page 5), Operations structured in two segments (page 5), Board of Directors' Report (page 32)

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic institutional investment by Bonnier Capital of up to SEK 140M (with SEK 50.3M initial tranche completed in December 2025) strengthening ownership base and securing funding for satellite constellation development and data services expansion.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Institutional ownership strengthened section (page 5), Board of Directors' Report (page 32), Top 10 shareholders table (page 18)

verified_key_information_units.information: Market positioning leveraged through AI-enhanced space-based data services and vertical integration in satellite manufacturing, with focus shifting toward recurring revenue streams from operational constellations rather than project-based hardware sales.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO Review (page 6), Invest in AAC Clyde Space section (page 8), Business model description (page 9-10)

verified_key_information_units.information: Liquidity management via expanded overdraft facility to SEK 50M (from SEK 30M) and maintained equity ratio of 80% (up from 71% in 2024), ensuring financial stability despite cash flow pressures from program delays and investment requirements.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Cash flow, liquidity and financial position section (page 33), Consolidated Balance Sheet (page 34), Significant events during the year (page 32)
